sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: No-ops Microsoft AppCenter's SDK bootstrap (configureAndStartServices / startServices) so the bundled telemetry/crash SDK never initialises.
Microsoft Teams ships no ad SDK; this strips the advertising-ID, ad-services and install-referrer permissions and disables any ad-SDK init provider.
Removes the third-party launcher-badge permission zoo Teams declares (Samsung/HTC/Sony/Huawei/OPPO/badger), which only add manifest bulk.
